title: Uniform-in-time stability and mean-field limit of the Cucker-Smale-type model with noncompact support
summary: We study the uniform-in-time stability and mean-field limit of an infinite Cucker--Smale-type (ICS-type) model in a fully noncompact setting. First, we clarify the main difficulties arising from the original ICS model and its corresponding kinetic Cucker--Smale (KCS) model, when the spatial support is noncompact. In particular, we show that the velocity diameter may remain constant in time, which invalidates the classical approach based on position and velocity diameters.
